description: Header file declaring utility functions for OS-related operations such as process path retrieval, file existence checks, system calls, PID handling, and OS info retrieval, within the 'beerocks' namespace.

classes.name: os_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for OS and process management tasks.

methods.name: get_process_path
methods.description: Retrieves the executable path of the current process.

methods.name: get_process_dir
methods.description: Retrieves the directory containing the current process's executable.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists.

methods.name: system_call
methods.description: Executes a system command, optionally in detached mode.

methods.name: system_call_with_output
methods.description: Executes a system command and captures its output.

methods.name: kill_pid
methods.description: Kills a process identified by pid read from a specific file.

methods.name: is_pid_running
methods.description: Checks whether a process is running based on a PID file.

methods.name: read_pid_file
methods.description: Reads a process ID from a specified file.

methods.name: write_pid_file
methods.description: Creates or updates a PID file.

methods.name: redirect_console_std
methods.description: Redirects console output to a specified log file.

methods.name: remove_residual_files
methods.description: Removes residual files from previous process runs.

methods.name: get_os_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name and version of the operating system.
